name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Squat over a dumbbell on the floor between your feet and grip it with one hand, back flat.
Drive through your legs and hips, and pull the dumbbell close to your body, then punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm overhead, then lower the dumbbell back to the floor with control.
Keep your back flat. Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
